fields.Name: T211 - Favorite a Record
fields.Description: Toggles the Favorite (star) control on a record and verifies the favorite state changes.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. In the record toolbar (the row of icons at the TOP-LEFT, just above the Details card), click the Favorite control — the STAR icon (its tooltip reads 'Add Favorite' or 'Remove Favorite'; the star is gold when favorited). Click it once to TOGGLE the favorite state. Verify the state visibly changed: the star fills/empties and/or the tooltip flips between 'Add Favorite' and 'Remove Favorite', with no error. (You do not need a specific final state — toggling once is success.) Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Favorite (star) control in the record toolbar was clicked
The favorite state visibly toggled (star fill changed and/or tooltip switched between Add/Remove Favorite)
No error messages or crash pages
